must_contain: The gateway session token comes from POST /api/hiecm/gateway/v3/sessions with clientId, clientSecret and grantType set to client_credentials, and it is the one call with no Authorization header.
The response carries the token in accessToken, which you send back as Authorization: Bearer on every other call.

In M2 the link token is a different token, asked for one patient before you link their care contexts: the call returns 202 Accepted and the linkToken arrives on your bridge at /api/v3/hip/token/on-generate-token.
notes: Group A, an imperative task phrase that could mean either of the two tokens a first-day developer confuses: it catches an answer that gives one token without saying which, or that treats the link token as arriving in the 202.
